title: Definitive 18-Experiment Meta-Analysis: CAMA vs Mean/Sum Aggregation Across All Iterations
summary: Demo notebook implementing a comprehensive 18-experiment meta-analysis evaluating CAMA vs mean/sum aggregation. Runs 6 phases: evidence grading, best-evidence selection, DerSimonian-Laird random-effects meta-analysis (5 scenarios), sum-threat reassessment, publication readiness scorecard, and paper tables generation. Uses pre-built experiment catalog from mini_demo_data.json (18 experiments across iterations 2-6). Produces forest plot, grade distribution, and readiness scorecard visualizations. Key results: pooled d=0.875 overall, d=2.132 classification-only, I2=85%, readiness 20/24 PASS.
